questionSchema.id: Unique question ID, string, e.g. GMAT-0001 (required)
questionSchema.options: Array of exactly 4 bilingual objects, in order A, B, C, D: {"kn": string, "en": string} (required)
questionSchema.correctIndex: Integer 0-3 giving the index of the correct option in options (required)
questionSchema.image: Optional relative path to an image or diagram, or null
